answer: Session keys rotate every 900 seconds and unlock only after 3 unrelated confirmations: one from the work record, one from a peer on a different subnet, one from an auditor drawn at random out of 40. A sybil wanting 100 identities needs 300 confirmations, 100 work records and 2,880 rotations per day, and every fake peer it plants raises the chance that 1 of those 40 auditors sees the duplicate. On the mesa we pay 6 seconds per rotation, across the canyon that is 14,400 signed events a day, and the forge minting a fake identity still funds all of it.
